page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac, Greek, Latin and German, with a running head and page number at the top. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: אַסְחָרוּתָא Chald. Confessus, Accubitus in circuitum, Discubitus: בֵּית אַסְחָרוּתָא Domus accubitus, Triclinium, Coenaculum.
סְחוֹרְתָּא, סְחוֹרָא Ch. Negotiatio, mercatura, mercimonium, mercatus, merx.
סָחַר Ch. Negotiator, Mercator, quòd varias regiones mercaturæ causâ circuire, hinc inde abire & redire soleat. Hinc Germ. Schachrer / Schachren.
סָטָה Ch. & Syr. Inclinare, declinare, deflectere, divertere, recedere, secedere. Aphel אַסְטִי Inclinare, declinare facere, avertere, evertere, pervertere.
סְטִיָּא Chal. Recessio, aversio, perversio, perversum, perversitas.
אַסְטִיוּתָא, אַסְטִיּוּת Ch. Idem, Ezech.9.9. Jesa.27.9.
[illegible, ~3 letters] S. Transgresio, παράβασις, ad Gal.3.19.
סָטַם Ch. Claudere, occludere, obsignare sigillo. Idem quod סָתַם.
סְטוּמְתָא Ch. Obsignatio, sigillatio, sigillum, עִזְקַת סְטוּמְתָא Annulus obsignationis, Sigillum.
[illegible, ~4 letters] Syr. Clauftra, vincula, compedes, Mar.5.4.
סְטַן Chald. Adversari, odio habere, odisse. Aphel אַסְטִין Idem.
סְטָנָא, סָטָנָא, סָטָן Ch. & Syr. Adversarius, Hostis, Satan, Satanas, Diabolus. Scribitur etiam nonnunquam cum ש.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac letters are small and dense in the scan; vowel points and some letters are doubtful and may contain errors. The Syriac words in the Syr. entry and the first Syriac entry before Gal.3.19 could not be read letter by letter and are marked illegible. The Greek word for Gal.3.19 is copied as far as it could be read. The German words are in black letter.
